author: Michael Reiger
name: auto_tag_modified
description: Automatically applies a tag to an image when its edit history has changed upon closing it from the darkroom.
description-extensive: When you edit a photo in the darkroom and then close it, this add-on automatically labels that photo as manually modified. It makes it easy to later find which pictures you've actually worked on versus ones you've only glanced at. Note that it does not catch styles applied from the lighttable, only real darkroom edits.
